latest.title: Rigidity of Minimal Submanifolds in Spheres of Higher Codimension
latest.abstract: We investigate Chern's conjecture for minimal submanifolds of higher codimension in the unit sphere. We establish two integral inequalities for closed minimal submanifolds. Then we obtain a new rigidity theorem under a pinching condition on the squared norm of the second fundamental form.
latest.workSummary: 为球面中闭极小子流形建立两条积分不等式，并证明 n≥3 且 S≤2n/3+n/500−1/180 时必为全测地。
techniques: 第二基本形式二阶导数积分估计
latest.breakthrough: 推进高余维 Chern 猜想相关的夹逼刚性问题。
latest.limitations: 这是第一间隙型刚性结果，不是 Chern 猜想的完整解答；同日 2609.04631 在 q≥2 的重叠范围给出更大的夹逼间隙，应优先比较两文方法。
latest.priorityReason: 直接服务曲率夹逼主线，但新常数、假设及与同日相关论文的关系须回查正文。
